claim_text: Google reports costly autonomous experiment runs and an evaluation shortcut requiring human rollback in a separate session.
notes: Report retains counts/time with context; neither daily incidents nor all compute wasted is inferred.

claim_text: Zapier reports a reward signal that stayed healthy while required API activity fell; its existing platform exposed the problem.
notes: Named supplier-hosted account; no quantified loss or daily frequency.

claim_text: Imprint reports workflow eval tuning and difficulty using stochastic results as blocking CI gates.
notes: Series context establishes organization; historical account, not current unresolved support ticket.

claim_text: Imprint reports daily workflow review and a successful code-driven alternative for suitable tasks.
notes: Same organization; daily review does not imply daily dangerous failure.

claim_text: Navan reports recurring evaluator supervision and human handoff using Braintrust.
notes: Existing response, not evidence of unmet INVARIANT demand.

claim_text: Braintrust describes stateful traces, datasets, scorers and CI integration.
notes: Documentation only; external state realism not guaranteed.

claim_text: Dropbox reports moving from manual evaluation coordination to a Braintrust pipeline.
notes: Vendor-hosted adoption counterevidence; not audited savings.

claim_text: LangSmith documents aligning evaluators with human labels and iterative feedback.
notes: Current official documentation, not only the older announcement.

claim_text: Mendmark describes tool-trajectory mutations to test existing evaluators.
notes: Primary author statement; illustrative example not production incident.

claim_text: evalmut is a published grader-mutation testing package.
notes: No independent execution or maturity assessment.

claim_text: HELIX documents private evaluator sidecars separated from optimizing agent containers.
notes: No independent security assurance inferred.

claim_text: Motion describes bespoke integration effort and adoption of Nango.
notes: Historical cost account; current adoption is counterevidence.

claim_text: Semgrep describes limitations and maintenance work with an earlier provider, then adopting Nango.
notes: No implication Nango leaves the same problem unsolved.

claim_text: Nango documents agent-assisted integration building, live tests and recorded API fixtures.
notes: Existing competing workflow; no independent success-rate benchmark.

claim_text: Outtake describes weekly reliability maintenance and an Inngest response covering retries, flow control and replay.
notes: Vendor-selected account; not universal safe replay of arbitrary side effects.

claim_text: cubic reports stuck agent runs and manual log work, followed by Inngest adoption.
notes: Existing solution, not independently measured unmet demand.

claim_text: Spotify reports ongoing fleet maintenance toil and internal agent investment.
notes: First-party success account, not a dissatisfied buyer.

claim_text: Ona, Codemod and Moderne describe cross-repository agent automation or fleet transformation.
notes: Competing coverage not universal correctness or customer satisfaction.

claim_text: INVARIANT architecture documents persistent Linux filesystem isolation but excludes running-process persistence and application-aware backups.
notes: Local architecture only; no runtime test repeated.

notes: Evaluation integrity is a research lead, not approved roadmap; buyer, validation protocol and gates are prospective hypotheses.
